name: 95350 · Modesto, CA
findings: ZIP 95350 (Modesto) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95350 (Modesto) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95350 (Modesto) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
